response.rationale: Reach is ~11.3 SD above baseline (far beyond noise), while CPM is essentially flat (z=0.54) — a demand-side reach surge rather than a price/competition move, which would show up in CPM. Own-action confound flag is false, so there is no signal this reflects the harness's own prior bid/budget change. Evidence points to a genuine market demand shock; magnitude capped at 10 given z > 10.
